categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determination of land ownership for specific parcels of land in Galle District. It involves the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement declaring determinations under the Registration of Title Act regarding multiple land parcels, including their extent, ownership status, and classification. The content falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters as defined in the classification criteria.
